A.name: A
A.query:
SELECT toDateTime(intDiv({{.end_timestamp_ms}}, 1000)) AS ts,
       if(e.emitted = 0 AND p.open_prs > 0, 1, 0) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT count() AS emitted
  FROM signoz_logs.logs_v2
  WHERE mapContains(attributes_string, 'loom.eta.estimate_id')
    AND NOT mapContains(attributes_string, 'loom.eta.outcome')
    AND attributes_string['loom.eta.authority'] != ''
    AND NOT mapContains(attributes_string, 'loom.eta.fallback')
    AND timestamp >= toUInt64({{.start_timestamp_ms}}) * 1000000
    AND timestamp < toUInt64({{.end_timestamp_ms}}) * 1000000
) AS e
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT sum(v) AS open_prs
  FROM (
    SELECT s.fingerprint AS fingerprint, argMax(s.value, s.unix_milli) AS v
    FROM signoz_metrics.samples_v4 AS s
    INNER JOIN signoz_metrics.time_series_v4 AS t USING (fingerprint)
    WHERE s.metric_name = 'loom.forge.stage_items'
      AND JSONExtractString(t.labels, 'state') IN ('review_requested', 'changes_requested', 'pr')
      AND s.unix_milli >= {{.start_timestamp_ms}}
      AND s.unix_milli < {{.end_timestamp_ms}}
    GROUP BY s.fingerprint
  )
) AS p

annotations.summary: Loom ETA records are not being emitted
annotations.description: No eta.estimate record stamped with loom.eta.authority reached SigNoz in the last 2 h while review-stage PRs are open (loom.forge.stage_items). eta.outcome rows (which also carry loom.eta.estimate_id) and estimates without the loom.eta.authority stamp (pre-#10498 builds that emit regardless of authority) and estimates from a #10897 fallback host (stamped loom.eta.fallback, never loom.eta.authority) do not count, so they cannot mask a silent authority. The query always returns one row, so a fully missing signal fires rather than reading as healthy. Run `loom-daemon eta doctor` on the ETA authority host: check config.authority, the 'last emit' line, and that an OTLP exporter is configured. Issue #10898 (incident 2026-10-07/08: authority loom-fleet-captain covered 2 repos with no OTLP exporter for ~31 h).
